card.name: Honorific and abbreviation openings after names
card.fires_on: The first part of a bracketed blessing or a dotted abbreviation right after a person's or company's name, such as 'peace' in '(peace be upon him)', 'z' in 'z"l', or the 'M' and 'S.T' in 'M.D.' and 'S.T.D.'.

modes.label: Peace be upon him
modes.description: The word peace opening a blessing in brackets after the name of an Imam or prophet.
modes.example: Imam Hussain ibn Ali (<<peace>> be upon him). Shias in particular

modes.label: Dotted titles and degrees
modes.description: The first letters of dotted degree or company-form abbreviations placed after a name.

modes.label: Other name-ending pieces
modes.description: Partway through a memorial suffix or a country name in a list.
modes.example: Morris Gradel<< z>>"l Our sincere appreciation to Yad
